hero.headline: Learning Today, Leading Tomorrow
hero.subheadline: A modern SSIBM experience for ambitious students, supportive families, and a connected academic community.

about.title: Founded with purpose
about.paragraph: Sri Siddhartha Education Society was founded in 1959 by Late Dr H M Gangadhariah with a mission to expand quality education for rural students, women, and underserved communities, inspired by the blessings of Acharya Vinobha Bhave.

whyChoose.title: Why students choose SSIBM
reasons: Strong academic direction with business, commerce, computing, and social science pathways.
Student-first learning environment with qualified faculty and practical exposure.
A legacy institution under SSES with a mission rooted in access and upliftment.
A campus experience being redesigned for easier admissions and communication.
A clear roadmap toward placements, parent updates, and digital support systems.
